visualReview.notes: Inspected all11 current portable/source-terrain frames. Freiburg Minster has a single stepped west tower, recessed pointed entrance with nested surrounds/dark vaulted backing and lower wood door, geometric clocks, open octagonal belfry and porous stone lattice spire. Long tiled nave, higher polygonal eastern choir/chapel ring, twin smaller cock turrets, large pointed aisle fields, clerestory glazing and flying buttresses retain the individual exterior. Distinct Romanesque transept has geometric rose/three rounded lower windows over a low Renaissance arcade. Added stepped front buttresses and thicker stone lattice members after the first renders; corrected the blue entrance backing to an opaque dark cavity. Fine sculpture, exact tracery/stained glass, temporary scaffold/market stalls and surrounding town omitted.
